dedup_limitations: The 11 events are actual first applicable status assignments before a stratum filled; 90 cap-rejected representatives were not additionally classified for group or SQL overlap. Exact-byte SQL hash uniqueness does not prove semantic or statistical independence.

selection_mechanism.label: Frozen lexical first-match stratification and result-independent representative selection
selection_mechanism.pair_rule: For each source-label group x stratum sort by token complexity, stable tie hash, rawline hash, and use lower median.
selection_mechanism.group_rule: Stable seeded group hash within fixed S1..S8 priority; at most four per stratum, one pair per source label, exclude exact SQL hash overlap.

provenance_limits.leetcode: Original file labels provide engineering grouping only. Source business origin, gold validity, and semantic independence remain unknown/unverified.
provenance_limits.calcite: 397 optimizer benchmark pairs counted; benchmark/index lacks independent rule/test provenance, excluded from primary selection as SOURCE_GROUP_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
provenance_limits.literature: 64 upstream rewritten pairs in 63 name-label groups; nonnatural controls, not used to fill primary strata.
provenance_limits.contract: PRESENT_JSON only means a nonempty benchmark-declared list of clause objects. It does not validate real business constraints. NULL_UNSPECIFIED is not absence of constraints.
provenance_limits.pair_labels: Selected original records have only constraint/file/index/pair/schema keys; a public pair is not evidence of natural correct-vs-defective SQL or a trusted hidden gold label.
provenance_limits.exposure: All 48,910 query slots were previously exposed by applicability scans. This round adds lexical development selection. Neither selected cases nor previously known reserve can be called a wholly unseen final test.
provenance_limits.reserve: Only existing scan ledger opaque exclusions summarized; no reserve file opened, identities reconstructed, or reserve SQL decoded in this task.
provenance_limits.science_status: HOLD; no automatic promotion or natural-defect claim.
